name: Ipsita Ganguli

sections.heading: Life and writing.
paragraphs: Ipsita Ganguli writes poetry and travel prose and takes an active interest in heritage and the arts. Her books include Of Love, Longing and Random Pondering and Rooted, India 75, and We the People. Alongside her writing, she has curated poetry events and developed literary conversations for audiences in Kolkata and online.

‘Blissfully Yours’, her poem in Kabita Live, imagines togetherness carried by clouds, rain, birds and a gentle breeze. The lovers build a shared heaven, then release it to the wind. Affection here becomes most sustaining when it allows freedom rather than possession.
